summary: IDF eliminated Hamas's Khan Yunis company commander Mahmud Mardawi in a targeted strike while continuing extensive demolition operations in southern Gaza. Heavy Israeli attacks struck southern Lebanon as Hezbollah drones were intercepted, and reports emerged of Iranian ballistic missile launches from Isfahan and Kerman provinces. Diplomatic tensions escalated as the US, UK, France, and Germany pushed an IAEA resolution on Iran's nuclear program while regional mediators attempted de-escalation.
key_points: IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Hamas Khan Yunis company commander Mahmud Mahmud Mardawi, who led the Oct 7 attack on Sufa base, in a strike in Khan Yunis (Source: @idf_telegram/25055).
IDF forces struck at fire directed at them east of the yellow line in northern Gaza, calling it a gross violation of the ceasefire agreement; no IDF casualties reported (Source: @idf_telegram/25046).
IDF is conducting extensive demolition of buildings and infrastructure east of Khan Yunis in southern Gaza according to Palestinian reports (Source: @yediotnews25/134663).
Duvdevan unit soldiers arrested five militants planning an attack in the Kibbutz area, seizing M16 rifles and additional weapons (Source: @New_security8200/203610).
Israeli army claims interception of a Hezbollah drone launched toward southern Lebanon; heavy Israeli attacks reported on southern Lebanon (Source: @naya_foriraq/89396).
Reports of ballistic missile launches from Kerman province, Iran, and missile fire from south of Isfahan, the first such launches since the 40-day war (Source: @shin_persian/9444).
UN report states Israel forcibly displaced over 33,000 Palestinians from three West Bank refugee camps between January and February 2025 (Source: @presstv/205525).
US, UK, France, and Germany are working to pass an IAEA board resolution referring Iran's nuclear case to the UN Security Security Council for the first time in 20 years (Source: @VahidOnline/78235).

sections.executive_summary: IDF eliminated Hamas's Khan Yunis company commander Mahmud Mardawi in a targeted strike while continuing extensive demolition operations in southern Gaza. Heavy Israeli attacks struck southern Lebanon as Hezbollah drones were intercepted, and reports emerged of Iranian ballistic missile launches from Isfahan and Kerman provinces. Diplomatic tensions escalated as the US, UK, France, and Germany pushed an IAEA resolution on Iran's nuclear program while regional mediators attempted de-escalation.
iran: Reports of ballistic missile launches from Kerman province, Iran, were posted with unconfirmed video; the source could not verify the footage (Source: @shin_persian/9448).

Missile fire was reported from south of Isfahan at 19:15 on Friday, described as the first such launch since the 40-day war; the launcher was identified as originating from the Najafabad area (Source: @mamlekate/104320).

The US, UK, France, and Germany are attempting to have the IAEA Board of Governors pass a resolution referring Iran's nuclear case to the UN Security Council; Iran previously had 440.9 kg of 60% enriched uranium, which the IAEA says could suffice for approximately 10 nuclear weapons if further enriched (Source: @VahidOnline/78235).

Trump stated Iran is only 'two to four weeks' from acquiring nuclear weapons and that US strikes halted this trajectory; he also claimed Iran's economy is collapsing with inflation potentially reaching 300% (Source: @VahidOnline/78225).

US Treasury cut critical financial arteries of Iran's government in Turkey, adding a Turkish bank and two affiliated financial institutions to its sanctions list as part of an 'economic expulsion operation' (Source: @mamlekate/104321).
Iran's Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf stated that true stability can only come through a homegrown security architecture, signaling Iran's defiance of Western pressure (Source: @presstv/205520).
Trump said he asked Xi Jinping not to interfere regarding Iran, claiming China is not significantly involved in the matter (Source: @SharghDaily/181861).

Reports of strong explosions in Jordan following launches from Iran were posted, though a senior US official later told Axios that no attack from Iran against US bases in Jordan occurred (Source: @almogboker78/18132, Source: @rodast_omiddana/80317).
israel: IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Hamas Khan Yunis company commander Mahmud Mahmud Mardawi in a strike in the Khan Yunis area of southern Gaza; the strike was conducted on Thursday (Source: @idf_telegram/25055).

IDF spokesperson reported fire directed at IDF forces operating east of the yellow line in northern Gaza, describing it as a gross violation of the Gaza ceasefire agreement; no IDF casualties were reported (Source: @idf_telegram/25046).

Duvdevan unit soldiers, operating under Shin Bet intelligence guidance, arrested five militants in the Kibbutz area of the Menashe Brigade who were planning an attack; they seized M16 rifles and additional weapons within less than ten minutes of arrival (Source: @New_security8200/203610).
Initial reports of shooting with no casualties were reported in Herzliya, with details still under investigation (Source: @yediotnews25/134654).
A stabbing attempt was documented at the Shechem Gate in Jerusalem, with the attacker and knife photographed (Source: @pkpoi).
Tali Gottlieb will be number 2 on the Otzma Yehudit list, and Amital Segal, chairman of the Unity Party, withdrew from the Knesset race (Source: @yediotnews25/134661, Source: @N12chat/225001).

The Tnuat Tzav 9 movement demanded complete demilitarization of Gaza and cessation of all aid to Hamas following the shooting at IDF forces, calling for the removal of Hamas rule (Source: @almogboker78/18128).
gaza_west_bank: IDF is conducting extensive demolition of buildings and infrastructure east of Khan Yunis in southern Gaza according to Palestinian reports, with operations continuing into the morning (Source: @yediotnews25/134663).

IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Hamas company commander Mahmud Mahmud Mardawi in Khan Yunis; he had commanded the attack on Sufa base during the Oct 7 massacre and participated in holding hostages in the Rafah area (Source: @idf_telegram/25055).
IDF spokesperson stated that fire was directed at IDF forces east of the yellow line in northern Gaza, calling it a gross violation of the ceasefire agreement (Source: @idf_telegram/25046).

UN report states Israeli forces forcibly displaced the entire Palestinian populations of three refugee camps in the occupied West Bank between January and February 2025, preventing their return and raising concerns of forcible transfer and ethnic cleansing (Source: @presstv/205525).

Five militants were arrested in the Kibbutz area by Duvdevan unit soldiers in a special operation coordinated with Shin Bet; the cell was planning to carry out attacks against Israeli civilians and security forces (Source: @New_security8200/203610).

The Tnuat Tzav 9 movement demanded that the political leadership stop strengthening Hamas, cease aid to Hamas, and halt preparations for Gaza rehabilitation, stating that as long as Hamas exists, there is no victory in Gaza (Source: @almogboker78/18128).
A stabbing attempt was documented at the Shechem Gate in Jerusalem, with the attacker and knife photographed (Source: @pkpoi).
lebanon: Israeli army claims interception of a drone launched by Hezbollah toward IDF forces in southern Lebanon (Source: @naya_foriraq/89396).

Heavy and powerful Israeli attacks on southern Lebanon were reported, with airstrike distribution maps shared via the Red Alert Lebanon platform (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80315, Source: @redlinkleb/40741).

The International Committee of the Red Cross facilitated the return of five detainees held in Israel back to Lebanon—one yesterday and four today—marking the first such transfers since October 2023 (Source: @yediotnews25/134660).

Red Alert Lebanon continues to operate as a volunteer-based early warning system for Lebanese civilians, relying on open-source intelligence and public reports to distribute alerts around the clock (Source: @redlinkleb/40742).
Warplanes were reported over the Western Bekaa area, with a live map shared showing military activity (Source: @redlinkleb/40714).
gulf_states: Pakistan, Qatar, and Oman remain in contact with both Iran and the United States to de-escalate tensions, according to a diplomatic source speaking to Al Arabiya English (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6821).
Trump stated that Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are bringing a proposal to Moscow to end the war, indicating diplomatic back-channel efforts involving Russia (Source: @SharghDaily/181859).
Trump stated that if any country misbehaves with the US, America has no commitment to engage in any trade with them, signaling broad economic pressure tactics (Source: @SharghDaily/181856).

F-16C Fighting Falcon jets from the 180th Fighter Wing (Ohio) departed Lajes Airport heading toward CENTCOM, initially supported by additional assets, as part of the Iran war deployment (Source: @shin_persian/9444).
Trump claimed the US has complete control over the Strait of Hormuz, stating they can intercept 30 to 40 boats every night and target their radar systems (Source: @VahidOnline/78225).
key_developments: IDF eliminated Hamas Khan Yunis company commander Mahmud Mardawi in a strike in Khan Yunis; he led the Oct 7 Sufa base attack and held hostages in Rafah, representing a significant tactical degradation of Hamas command structure (Source: @idf_telegram/25055).

Reports of ballistic missile launches from Kerman province, Iran, and missile fire from south of Isfahan—the first such launches since the 40-day war—signal potential escalation on the Iranian front (Source: @shin_persian/9448, Source: @mamlekate/104320).
IDF is conducting extensive building demolitions east of Khan Yunis in southern Gaza, indicating continued large-scale military operations in the enclave (Source: @yediotnews25/134663).

Heavy Israeli attacks struck southern Lebanon while Hezbollah drones were intercepted; the ICRC facilitated the return of five detainees from Israel to Lebanon, signaling possible humanitarian channels opening (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80315, Source: @yediotnews25/134660).

US, UK, France, and Germany are pushing an IAEA resolution to refer Iran's nuclear program to the UN Security Council; Iran previously held 440.9 kg of 60% enriched uranium, enough for approximately 10 nuclear weapons if further enriched (Source: @VahidOnline/78235).

US Treasury cut Iran's critical financial arteries in Turkey, adding a Turkish bank and two affiliated institutions to sanctions, as part of an 'economic expulsion operation' targeting Iran's government finances (Source: @mamlekate/104321).

Pakistan, Qatar, and Oman remain in contact with Iran and the US to de-escalate tensions, while Trump sent Witkoff and Kushner to Moscow with a proposal to end the war, indicating active multi-front diplomatic efforts (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6821, Source: @SharghDaily/181859).
sections.threat_assessment: Iran's nuclear program remains a critical threat, with the IAEA estimating Iran previously held 440.9 kg of 60% enriched uranium—sufficient for approximately 10 nuclear weapons if further enriched—while Iran is reportedly only two to four weeks from weapons-grade capability according to Trump's statements. Iranian ballistic missile launches from Isfahan and Kerman provinces indicate continued offensive capability despite ongoing strikes on Iranian infrastructure. Hezbollah maintains drone and missile capabilities in southern Lebanon, as evidenced by intercepted drones targeting IDF forces. The potential for broader regional escalation remains high as Iran's nuclear trajectory, Hezbollah's operational activity, and ongoing Gaza operations create multiple simultaneous flashpoints.
sections.regional_response: Regional mediators including Pakistan, Qatar, and Oman are actively engaged in de-escalation efforts between Iran and the US, while Trump dispatched Witkoff and Kushner to Moscow with a peace proposal. The US, UK, France, and Germany are pursuing an IAEA resolution to refer Iran's nuclear case to the UN Security Council, though Russia and China—both holding veto power—may block action. Trump's economic pressure campaign includes cutting Iran's financial arteries in Turkey and threatening trade isolation for non-compliant nations. Israel's regional posture remains aggressively defensive, with extensive military operations across Gaza, Lebanon, and the West Bank alongside interception of threats from Hezbollah and potential Iranian missile fire.
sections.intelligence_notes: The elimination of Hamas's Khan Yunis company commander Mardawi represents a significant intelligence achievement, following extensive Shin Bet operational work that identified and targeted a key figure involved in the Oct 7 attack and hostage holding. Duvdevan unit operations in the Menashe Brigade demonstrate continued Shin Bet-led counterterrorism success in the West Bank, with five militants arrested and M16 weapons seized within minutes of deployment. Reports of Iranian missile launches from Isfahan and Kerman provinces, described as the first since the 40-day war, require further verification but suggest Iran may be testing Israeli defenses or signaling escalation. The ICRC-mediated detainee transfers from Israel to Lebanon indicate that humanitarian channels remain functional despite active hostilities. US Treasury sanctions on Iran's Turkish financial networks represent a coordinated economic warfare effort complementing military and diplomatic pressure.
